prompt: At a family gathering, your visiting cousin understands only a little of the language everyone is chatting in, and has drifted to the edge of the room looking lost. What is the most welcoming response?

options.text: Carry on, since they can join in if they really want to
Speak much louder and slower at them in front of everyone
Ask them to entertain everyone with something from their home town
Go over, include them in a smaller conversation, and translate the main jokes and stories as you go

explanation: Joining them at the edge and bridging the language brings them into the gathering in a relaxed way instead of putting them on display.
